_what: SSOT for the film-look grade library: every third-party asset, where it came from, its hash, its license, and where it installs. Writer: a human editing this file (sources) + tools/grade-library.py fetch --record (hashes/contents). Reader: tools/grade-library.py fetch/install/verify, and anyone asking 'where did this LUT come from'. Fails when wrong: an asset on a node whose provenance cannot be reproduced, or a silently changed upstream file.

assets.role: print-stock emulations. INPUT IS LOG, not Rec.709: Melara's page says 'PFE LUTs expect log film scans in Rec709 colour space' and puts a CST to Cineon (or ARRI LogC) with Rec.709 gamut before them. Measured 2026-09-12: the 2383 grey axis matches Resolve's shipped Cineon-input 2383 to three decimals
assets.license: free download from the author's site, no license text in the archive
assets.upstream: Juan Melara, files dated 2020-03-10 inside the archive
assets.input: Cineon Film Log (or ARRI LogC3), Rec.709 primaries
